prompt: Fossils are almost always found in one particular type of rock. Which type, and why?

options.text: Igneous rock, because lava preserves bodies quickly
Metamorphic rock, because heat hardens the remains
Sedimentary rock, because remains are buried gently in layers of sediment
All rock types contain fossils equally often

explanation: Sedimentary rock forms from layers of sand, mud and silt that bury dead organisms gently. Igneous and metamorphic processes involve heat that would destroy the remains.
